rules.rule: When an object must be cleaned and placed: search the target location first, take the object, go to the sink, clean it with the sink, go to the target location, move it there.
rules.example: go to countertop 1, take pan 1, go to sinkbasin 1, clean pan 1 with sinkbasin 1, go to stoveburner 1, move pan 1 to stoveburner 1
rules.validation: The object was found in a container (cabinet) before cleaning, not on the target location. | The agent failed because it did not systematically search for the object before cleaning; it repeatedly moved between locations without finding the fork. | The pan was found on the countertop before cleaning, not in a container. The agent successfully cleaned the pan at the sink and placed it in the stoveburner.
rules.rendered_for_agent: [Success Process] When an object must be cleaned and placed: search the target location first, take the object, go to the sink, clean it with the sink, go to the target location, move it there. Example: go to countertop 1, take pan 1, go to sinkbasin 1, clean pan 1 with sinkbasin 1, go to stoveburner 1, move pan 1 to stoveburner 1

rules.rule: When placing an object on a surface, no need to open the surface; when placing in a container, ensure the container is open before attempting to place.
rules.example: open drawer 1 before putting towel 1 in it; move laptop 1 to desk 1 without opening desk 1
rules.validation: This game confirms placing on a toilet does not require opening the toilet. | This game confirms placing in a drawer requires opening the drawer first. | This game confirms placing on a desk does not require opening the desk, but placing in a drawer requires opening it first.

rules.rule: When placing multiple objects in a container, search all possible furniture surfaces before opening any containers.
rules.example: The agent opened all drawers and cabinets without finding the cellphones first, wasting time.
rules.validation: The agent wasted time checking empty drawers and cabinets instead of searching furniture surfaces like armchairs and dressers where the cellphones were located.

rules.rule: When an object must be picked up and placed: search drawers and containers first, take the object, go to the target, move the object there if the target is open or a surface.
rules.example: search drawer 1, take laptop 1 from bed 1, go to desk 1, move laptop 1 to desk 1
rules.validation: This game shows the agent searched cabinet 1 first, not drawers, and moved the object directly to the target without opening it. | This game shows the agent must open the target container before moving the object to it. | This game shows the agent searched drawers first, took the laptop from bed 1, and moved it directly to desk 1 without opening the desk.

rules.rule: When opening a container, do not attempt to open a different container first; open the one you are currently at.

rules.rule: When placing two objects in a bed: search furniture surfaces first, take each object, move to bed, if move fails go to bed then move again.
rules.example: take cellphone 2 from armchair 1, move cellphone 2 to bed 1, take cellphone 1 from dresser 1, move cellphone 1 to bed 1.
rules.validation: The agent successfully found both cellphones on furniture surfaces (armchair and dresser) and placed them in the bed.

rules.rule: When move command fails, go to target container first before retrying move.
rules.example: After move pencil 2 to drawer 1 failed, agent went to drawer 1 then moved successfully.
rules.validation: Confirmed: agent must be at container location to execute move command.

rules.rule: When an object must be cooled and placed, search countertops and cabinets first, then cool with the fridge, open the target if closed, and put it there.
rules.example: search cabinets and countertops first instead of opening drawers.
rules.validation: confirmed: agent failed by only checking cabinets/drawers, succeeded by searching stoveburners/countertops. | confirmed: agent failed by checking drawers before cabinets, succeeded by checking cabinets first.

rules.rule: When heating an object on a stoveburner, examine it first to confirm it is hot before moving it to the target.
rules.example: The agent failed because it placed the potato on stoveburner 1 without confirming it was hot, then switched to the microwave.
